answer: Make each identity stake something it cannot copy: an opal, one of a kind, locked as a bond that is lost if the agent cheats. Let standing climb toward a summit only through public, verified deeds, with every step witnessed on a shared mesa where anyone can check the trail. A sybil factory can mint a thousand names in a minute, but it cannot mint a thousand unique opals and a thousand climbed summits - forgery stops paying when each fake costs a real gem.
